tactics: intro m α β _ _ f l acc
intro m α β _ _ f l acc <;> induction l generalizing acc <;> simp [List.filterMapM.loop]

intro m α β _ _ f l <;> induction l with | nil => intro acc; simp [List.filterMapM.loop] | cons a l ih => intro acc; simp only [List.filterMapM.loop, map_bind]; congr; funext b; cases b <;> simp [ih (acc := _ :: acc), ih (acc := [_]), ih (acc := acc)]
intro m α β _ _ f l acc <;> induction l generalizing acc <;> simp_all [List.filterMapM.loop]
